purpose: Prospective, immutable candidate-level evaluation of the three original hole-pair policies; not production deployment.

historical_exclusion.reason: All Nov 5-8 outcomes or candidate availability may already have been inspected; cannot retrospectively reuse any as independent confirmation.

method.priorities: No selection by realized outcomes, betting odds, post-result weights, or prior cohort winners.

event_universe.source: All future original four_mode_forecasts race IDs in an immutable main snapshot, captured before the eligibility cutoff, for each explicitly dispatched research collection batch.
event_universe.race_identity: 12-digit YYYYMMDD + 2-digit venue + 2-digit race number; only one first accepted frozen record per identity
event_universe.candidate_creation: Original source immutable Git blob and SHA256, deterministic three-arm candidate digest, original acquisition timestamp, selector SHA, local start and finish, and cutoff.
event_universe.remote_receipt_definition: Independent append-only receiver proves it first accepted the exact candidate digest with server-controlled timestamp strictly earlier than T-12; post-hoc GitHub readback or Actions artifact upload time alone is insufficient.
event_universe.official_inputs_required: Six complete official beforeinfo/exhibition boat records and complete 120-way odds, with acquisition and original save time strictly before T-12.
event_universe.invalid: Absent, contradictory or late source or candidate receipt, unknown weather/status, missing official inputs, duplicate/conflicting candidate digest, mutated method or candidates -> unverified/rejected; never count as hit or miss.
event_universe.result_rules: Open independent results only after all eligibility, chronology, source and candidate checks. Official cancellation is an excluded event with cited official evidence, never hit/miss. Unpublished result remains pending; conflicting or invalid result blocks score.

pilot.role: feasibility and diagnostic only; no confirmatory significance or model promotion

sequential_cohorts.inclusion_integrity: Freeze order and all ineligible reason codes before outcomes; log completeness against every original forecast/scheduled race; no cherry-picking, duplicate counting, replacing failed cases, switching policy, post-hoc subgroup or early stopping.

metrics.primary: Paired Top10 exact trifecta hit/miss difference against baseline in the same race, same 10-ticket budget.
metrics.significance: Two-sided exact McNemar p for each comparison; Holm correction over both; familywise alpha=0.05; confirmation cohort only.
secondary: coverage and missingness by pre-cutoff status
metrics.prohibitions: Never use exploratory Nov 6/7 significance or past winning combinations to rank, tune, stop, promote or retroactively amend candidate arms.

formal_accuracy_recognition_requires: frozen confirmation cohort reached and pass predeclared test

notes: Protocol predeclared on Draft PR #1685 for days 20261109 onward only. Its presence alone supplies no actual first-receipt service or proof. PR #1693 owns separate all-four-mode future work; do not merge its cohorts with this hole-pair study.
